title: The misunderstood are often just ahead of schedule
paragraphs: The misunderstood are often just ahead of schedule

Every revivalist looks like a rebel before the plan is revealed.
They called Noah crazy—then started swimming lessons.

Luke 4:24 (ESV)
“Truly, I say to you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.”
🕊 — Jesus Himself declaring the cost of true calling: rejection precedes recognition.
